1.e4 c5 2.Nf3 e6 3.d4 cxd4 4.Nxd4 a6 5.B.strategy: Castles before committing the centre: the king is safe and e4 stays solidly guarded by the bishop on d3. White keeps the choice between central and kingside plans open.
Solid: the pawn takes control of e5, so White's e-pawn cannot advance for free. Black heads for a compact set-up and castling, and has to know how to meet an attack on the kingside.
